label: technique
correctness: ece and oscr use argmax(predict_proba) == label; closed_accuracy uses predict(); closed_accuracy_argmax uses argmax(predict_proba)

fpr95_conventions.fpr95_known_pos: fraction of NOVEL rows accepted as known at the threshold retaining 95% of KNOWN rows (known positive, OpenOOD convention; the quantity the manuscript text describes)
fpr95_conventions.fpr95_novel_pos: fraction of KNOWN rows flagged novel at the threshold detecting 95% of NOVEL rows (novel positive; the quantity earlier versions reported)
fpr95_conventions.tpr95_achieved_*: TPR actually achieved at the 95% threshold of the matching convention; interpolation can leave it slightly below 0.95 and ties can push it above, up to 1.0
